title: F05 — Capture
tagline: a photo is captured, written, hashed and linked to a location — offline, before any upload exists.

series.name: SiteLog: an iOS app and its API, built

intro: Sprint S3 · 24h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: a photo is captured, written, hashed and linked to a location — offline, before any upload exists.
  • Demo — offline: airplane mode → project → location → photo with its hash; relaunch shows it.
  • Demo — signed in: the capture row (not the bytes) appears on the second device; bytes come with F06.

  • Starts from: F03 (Capture entity, CaptureRepository) and F04 (sync engine).
